scripts.payments:check: wrangler d1 execute DB --remote --command="SELECT id,mp_order_id,status,amount_cents,created_at,approved_at FROM payments ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 10;"
scripts.attempts:check: wrangler d1 execute DB --remote --command="SELECT id,device_id,payment_id,mac,attempt_number,status,starts_at,ends_at FROM access_attempts ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 15;"
